```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Set the plot style
sns.set(style='whitegrid')

# Create a boxplot for camera prices by sensor type
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.boxplot(x='sensor_type', y='price_usd', data=df, palette='muted')

# Set plot title and labels
plt.title('Camera Prices by Sensor Type', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Sensor Type', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=12)

# Rotate x-axis labels for better readability
plt.xticks(rotation=45)

# Save the plot as a PNG file
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
